verdict.rationale: Ledgy's marketing says users can 'bring historical transaction data into your cap table, with documents attached,' a first-party claim of importing an existing cap table with supporting documents. It is a single thin marketing line with no description of the import mechanism. The automated error flags it mentions are for compliance risks, not import validation, so they are not credited. Missing for 10: a guided import or migration workflow, spreadsheet or other-platform import paths, import validation, reconciliation against source documents, and any detailed docs or hands-on corroboration.
